annotation.bound_parties_text: The notice only announces intended draft amendments to the Civil Aviation Regulations and Technical Standards and invites comments; it names no bound parties.
annotation.dates_quote: Interested persons are hereby invited to submit written comments on these draft Amendments on or before the 22 February 2023
annotation.robot_provision_quote: intends, in terms of Section 155(1) of the Civil Aviation Act,2009 (Act No.13 of 2009) and on the recommendation of the Civil Aviation Regulations Committee (CARCom), to amend the Civil Aviation Regulations,2011
